g.text: Wildfire area burned by land cover type
Total area of land that was burned as a result of wildfires each year. This captures all vegetation burning of a
certain size; some planned and agricultural burns are captured, however a lot of cropland burning is too
Data source: Global Wildfire Information System (2026)
Note: For these historical estimates, we rely on data based on the NASA MCD64 MODIS sensor, which, according to the data provider, might
underestimate burnt areas and fire occurrences.
